verdict.rationale: Warp publishes its own endpoint-level API reference pages (e.g. api-reference/company/get-company), an API definition that documentation-aware AI tools can use, and quickstart code examples. Nothing shows the reference is interactive or that its examples can be run from the docs, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. missing for 10: an interactive 'try it' console or playground, examples runnable from the docs, a publicly reachable OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Get the company associated with your API key, including its unmasked EIN.
List stored worker bank accounts, newest first.
Use it to generate clients, configure API development tools, or give documentation-aware AI tools access to the Warp API definition.
Call the API from Node.js, the browser, or any `fetch`-capable runtime with idiomatic, fully typed code.
